question: Where was the Drone Training Centre inaugurated by Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arts and Commerce College, Indore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav inaugurated a Drone Training Centre at the Arts and Commerce College in Indore.**
 
• The initiative aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision to make India the global leader in drone technology by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Drone Training Institute is established by the Flying Club.**
 
• CM Yadav encouraged collaboration with IIT Bhopal to make drone technology accessible to women, youth, and farmers.
 
• Himachal Pradesh has also announced drone stations to revolutionise disaster management with a budget allocation of Rs 800 crore.
 
• The Union Government supports the growth of the drone ecosystem under the 'NAMO Drone Didi' initiative, empowering women in the agriculture sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Drone Training Centre in Indore__

 __
 
• Located at the Arts and Commerce College, Indore.
 
• Focuses on training and advancing the use of drone technology across various sectors.
 
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh Drone Stations__
 __
 
• Initiative by CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu to address disaster management challenges posed by climate change.
 
• A budget of Rs 800 crore has been allocated for establishing drone stations.
 
 
 
• 'NAMO Drone Didi' Initiative__
 
 
• Aims to empower women in agriculture by promoting the use of drones for farming activities.
 
• Part of the Union Government's strategy to boost the drone industry in India.
